observations: Transverse layout with aluminum cylinder head and block.
Four spark plug wells visible on the top of the valve cover in photo 2.
Black plastic oil filler cap on the right side of the valve cover.

A barcode sticker is present on the timing cover in photo 0, but the text is not legible.
A small sticker with a bold letter 'E' is affixed to the front of the valve cover in photo 0.

claims.claim: Complete engine for toyota vehicles like SUVs and Crossovers Toyota RAV4 (Second generation XA20)
claims.evidence: The engine's external design and components are consistent with the Toyota 2AZ-FE engine used in the second-generation RAV4.
There is no visual evidence, such as a video of the engine running, to confirm its operational status.
Internal mechanical sounds cannot be assessed from static photos.
The external condition does not provide a reliable indication of internal mileage.
The presence of grey sealant is typical of factory assembly but does not guarantee the engine has never been serviced or opened.
